info.name: Fragment Ledger GraphQL API
info.description: GraphQL-first ledger API for engineering teams. OAuth2 client-credentials for auth; a single region-scoped GraphQL endpoint (https://api.fragment.dev/graphql) for schema, ledgers, entries, balances, and reconciliation. All write mutations are idempotent via an idempotency key (ik).

request.description: Exchange client_id/client_secret (Basic auth) for a Bearer access token that expires in ~1 hour.
Store / version a ledger Schema (chart of accounts + entry types).
Create a new ledger from a stored Schema.
Retrieve a ledger's configuration, schema, and accounts.
Post a balanced double-entry ledger entry. The ik makes retries safe.
Reverse a previously posted ledger entry.
Read overall balances for a ledger.
Read the debit/credit lines behind an account.
Reconcile a transaction against external money movement, idempotent by transaction ID.
